description: Impairment axis: P(life-altering | band, region) = sum over injury types of P(type | event, region) x P(meets IOGP | type). Life-altering is tested against the IOGP permanent impairment criteria (FPI definitions s3.5); LIFE prevails at the hand (sif-definition.md s5.5). Computed by scripts/sif/impairment.py, which writes each mapped band's life_altering block.

amputation.basis: IOGP 3.5.1 automatic (through a joint); LIFE counts any body part

fracture_hand.basis: Gabbe et al. 2011 hand/wrist 0.60 not recovered at 12 mo is an upper bound (multiply injured, GOSE)

fracture_limb.basis: MacDermid et al. 2003 distal radius, any difficulty at 1 yr (over-inclusive)

fracture_spine.basis: Leucht et al. 2009: 11% complete, 25% any neurological deficit

tbi_moderate_severe.basis: TRACK-TBI (Nelson et al. 2023): 28% dependent at 1 yr

tbi_mild.basis: TRACK-TBI (Nelson et al. 2019): 53% vs 38% controls with GOSE<8 at 12 mo

tendon_flexor.basis: Rigo et al. 2016: 52% fair/poor Strickland at 7 mo

tendon_extensor.basis: Mehdinasab et al. 2012: 25% fair/bad Miller at 12 mo (referral)

nerve_digital.basis: Dunlop et al. 2019: <25% normal s2PD; protective sensation usually regained

eye_serious.basis: Cillino et al. 2008: 52% worse than 6/12, hospitalised; Bahrain 2017: 9.5% occupational

burn_grafted.basis: Goverman et al. 2017: 33% with a contracture at discharge

minor.basis: Cuts, bruises, sprains, abrasions without tendon or nerve involvement do not meet the criteria

burn_graft_share.basis: Share of DART burns needing a graft. No source found

eye_serious_share.basis: Share of DART eye cases comparable to an admitted injury. No source found; most are foreign bodies

head_mild_tbi_share.basis: Share of DART head cases that are concussion. No source found

head_fracture_as_tbi_ms.basis: Fractures at the head are taken as a proxy for moderate or severe brain injury

hand_tendon_share.basis: Sorock et al. 2002: tendon damage 27 of 1,166 occupational hand injuries

hand_nerve_share.basis: Sorock et al. 2002: nerve damage 9 of 1,166

independence.basis: BLS publishes nature and part of body as marginals; nature is assumed independent of region within an event, except amputations, which are all placed at the hand (upper bound)

bls.source: BLS SOII biennial 2023-24 DART counts, All U.S., OIICS v3 (event or exposure; chemicals by source)
